title: Pre-Big-Bang and Cyclic Cosmologies
bottleneck: Bouncing and cyclic models (ekpyrotic, matter-bounce, conformal cyclic cosmology) claim to replace inflation, but each requires exotic matter, fine-tuned initial conditions, or unproven high-energy physics, and none reproduces the full suite of CMB observations as economically as inflation. Their distinctive predictions (e.g., non-Gaussian signatures, gravitational-wave spectra) are mostly untested. Ekpyrotic models predict negligible primordial gravitational waves, a sharp contrast with large-field inflation that future B-mode searches could test.
why_it_blocks: The origin of the universe has credible-sounding alternatives to inflation that cannot be decisively tested. Their survival as unfalsified alternatives keeps the field honest but consumes theoretical effort.
current_state: No cyclic or bounce model is favored by data; they survive as unfalsified alternatives rather than competitors. Until such discriminating tests mature, the alternatives remain viable but uncompelling to most cosmologists.
